description: All-Claude family picks — claude-haiku-4-5 handles low-cost flash exploration, while claude-sonnet-5 runs standard, pro, max, and vision as the strongest Claude model within OCP's $3/$15 cost cap. Claude Opus 5.5 ($4/$20) and Fable 5.1 ($10/$50) exceed the cap and are excluded. Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
